# Drawesome drawing

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Built-in tools and hand-off · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/ui/sketch.ts on the Tools tab: seven pens, eight colours, an eraser that removes only the touched part, straight lines with Shift or the L lock, a toolbar whose chosen pen opens out to show its name, keys 1 to 7, E, L, Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y, undo and redo, SVG and PNG export, kept on the device; tests/sketch.test.ts

## What is missing

drawing over the map itself; pressure and smoothing; the deploy wizard and site have no board
